items.exampleEn: Each competitor has three chances to jump.
items.exampleZh: 每位參賽者有三次跳躍機會。

items.exampleEn: The race needs a sponsor to pay for the prizes.
items.exampleZh: 這場賽跑需要贊助商來支付獎品費用。

items.exampleEn: He played as a defender for ten years.
My uncle watches boxing on TV every weekend.
items.exampleZh: 我叔叔每個週末都看電視上的拳擊。

items.exampleEn: The young golfer practices for six hours a day.
items.exampleZh: 那位年輕的高爾夫球選手每天練習六小時。

items.exampleEn: The swimmer trained twice a day before the big race.
items.exampleZh: 那位游泳選手在大賽前每天練兩次。

items.exampleEn: The diver jumped from a high cliff into the sea.
items.exampleZh: 那位潛水員從高高的懸崖跳進海裡。

items.sentenceEn: Boxing is a popular sport in many countries.
items.sentenceZh: 拳擊在許多國家是很受歡迎的運動。

items.audioEn: The swimming race is moved to Sunday because the pool needs cleaning.
items.audioZh: 游泳比賽改到星期天，因為泳池需要清理。
options: The pool is closed on Sunday.
The weather will be bad that day.
A swimmer is sick and can't race.
The pool has to be cleaned.

items.sentenceEn: The company is looking for a sponsor for the festival.
items.sentenceZh: 這家公司正在為節慶活動找贊助商。

items.sentenceEn: Two divers checked their equipment before going into the water.
items.sentenceZh: 兩位潛水員下水前檢查了裝備。

items.stemEn: Every ____ in the race got a medal and a T-shirt.
items.stemZh: 這場賽跑的每位參賽者都拿到獎牌和一件 T 恤。

items.stemEn: The ____ stopped the other team from scoring.
items.stemZh: 那位後衛擋下了對方的得分機會。

items.passageEn: Our town's summer sports day had something for everyone. In the morning, swimmers raced in the lake, and two divers showed some amazing jumps. In the afternoon, there was a boxing match for adults and a golf contest. The winner was a young golfer who is only twelve. A local bakery was the main sponsor, so every competitor got free bread. Later, in the football final, our best defender hurt his knee, but we still won.
items.passageZh: 我們鎮上的夏季運動日，每個人都能找到喜歡的活動。早上，游泳選手在湖裡比賽，兩位跳水選手做了很精彩的跳水動作。下午有成人拳擊賽和高爾夫比賽。冠軍是一位才十二歲的年輕高爾夫球選手。一家當地麵包店是主要贊助商，所以每位參賽者都拿到免費麵包。後來在足球決賽中，我們最好的後衛傷了膝蓋，但我們還是贏了。

options: 跳水比賽和足球友誼賽
湖上划船比賽和潛水展示

referenceEn: She is the fastest swimmer in our school.
She is the fastest swimmer at our school.
rubricZh: swimmer 表示「游泳者」，例如 the fastest swimmer 等說法

referenceEn: My brother takes boxing lessons twice a week.

rubricZh: 用 boxing 表示「拳擊」（例如 boxing lessons、boxing classes 等）
